answers.project_description: A comprehensive client management SaaS platform for agencies to manage clients, projects, invoices, and communications
answers.problem_statement: There's no single platform built specifically for web/digital agencies that handles the full client lifecycle
answers.target_users: Web and digital agency owners and their staff (account managers, project managers, developers)
answers.key_goals: Migrate from Laravel 11 to Next.js 15 with full feature parity across 55+ features; deploy to production; eliminate dependency on legacy PHP infrastructure
answers.voice_tone: Professional and direct — clear, agency-grade language without fluff
answers.design_principles: Simplicity over features; performance first; reliability over novelty

tech_stack.email: Resend 3 (primary transactional) + Microsoft 365 connector + Google Workspace connector

answers.tdd_strictness: Strict — tests required before implementation (red → green → refactor)
answers.commit_strategy: Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, refactor:, chore:, perf:, docs:, test:, ci:)
answers.code_review: Required for all non-trivial changes — use code-reviewer agent after every feature
answers.verification_checkpoints: After each phase completion — verify before moving to the next phase of a track
